title: [AUG-181] Mic mute/unmute during recording: gain-node mute, controls in every view, hotkey, gap markers, muted-speech hint
why_we_need_this: Rodion's feedback (Feature Request 6, @docs/feedback/2026-11-rodion-feedback.md): in an office, background noise is recorded and pollutes the transcript, and August has no way to mute the microphone without stopping the recording. Research AUG-174 agreed the approach and UI on the mockup @docs/mockups/AUG-174/mic-mute.html (Variant 1 · Control everywhere). Users can silence their side for any stretch of a call while the system track, the timeline and the live transcript keep running.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Mute engine: a GainNode sits between micSource and recordDest in @client/src/components/FileUpload.tsx (graph at ~380-390). Mute ramps the gain to 0 in about 15 ms and unmute ramps it back to 1. The mic file keeps its wall-clock length: a 5-min recording muted from 1:00 to 3:00 produces a mic track 5:00 ±1 s long, and the [Them] lines after 3:00 stay aligned with [Me].
- [ ] Re-attach after device loss (reattachMic, ~456-480) connects the new source into the gain node, so a muted state survives a device switch.
- [ ] Fallback when the Web Audio graph is unavailable (recordCtx null, plain browser tab): mute sets track.enabled = false on the raw mic track and re-applies it to a re-acquired track.
- [ ] Mute resets to off at the start of every recording.
- [ ] Live: while muted, no new [Me] lines appear and [Them] lines continue. The live Pause and the mute are independent: each one can be toggled while the other is active.
- [ ] Post-recording: the batch transcript has no [Me] segments inside the muted ranges. System capture (WASAPI / Stereo Mix / VB-Cable on Windows, audiotee / BlackHole on macOS) is unchanged.
- [ ] Standard view: during recording the top-right Mic circuit node becomes the mute toggle. Unmuted it reads "Mic"; muted it shows a slashed-mic glyph, the label "Muted" and a red ring. The live top bar has a "Mute mic" / "Unmute mic" button after Pause, red-filled when muted.
- [ ] Compact widgets, as in mockup Variant 1. Dock Strip: a [ MUTE ] / [ UNMUTE ] button in the foot and a red MIC OFF tag in the head. Dock Square: a mic icon button, and the tag "SYS · MIC OFF" when muted. Ghost Caption: a mic button in the hover tools and a MIC OFF tag that stays visible while muted. Ghost Coin: a red 2px border and "MUTED" under the time, plus [ MUTE ] / [ UNMUTE ] in the expanded actions. CompactSnapshot / GhostState carry micMuted; GhostCommand adds 'mute' and 'unmute'.
- [ ] Hotkey: a global Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+M toggles mute while recording and does nothing when not recording. Settings → General has a configurable "Mute hotkey" next to the Record hotkey. @electron/src/hotkey.ts no longer calls globalShortcut.unregisterAll() per change, so the record and mute hotkeys coexist, and a conflict shows the existing "already in use" error.
- [ ] Tray menu: "Mute microphone" carries a check mark while muted and is shown only while recording.
- [ ] Mute intervals: the upload sends muteIntervals [{startMs, endMs}] (relative to micStartedAt) and the session stores them in session.json. They are not shown in Settings or diagnostics.
- [ ] Gap marker: the live transcript shows a "— mic muted —" divider at each mute, and the final transcript (view + transcript.md) has a "— mic muted mm:ss–mm:ss —" line at each interval, placed in time order by the merger.
- [ ] Speaking-while-muted hint: an analyser taps the raw mic before the gain node. After about 2 s of speech (same RMS gate as the live chunker) while muted, a non-blocking hint "You're muted in August" appears in the standard view and as a tag in compact widgets, and it clears on unmute or after 5 s of silence.
- [ ] Verified on Windows (dev build, server capture and picker modes). macOS is checked in a release build or listed as pending in the card. Typecheck and the existing tests pass.
important_constraints:
Design: mockup @docs/mockups/AUG-174/mic-mute.html, Variant 1 (chosen 2026-11-03 in AUG-174). 0 border-radius. Red = muted state, so it never looks like the yellow Pause.
Do NOT use MediaRecorder.pause or track.stop for mute: either one desyncs the mic and system tracks (2026-10-29 "no recording pause" decision).
Mute is renderer-only on both platforms. Do not touch the system-capture code in systemCapture.ts. Electron main and hotkey changes must work on Windows and macOS (CommandOrControl).
The OS mic indicator stays on while muted (by design). Tooltip: "Mute in August's recording" (it does not mute Zoom/Meet/Teams).
Known limit: if the mic reaches the system track (Stereo Mix "Listen to this device", a VB-Cable/Voicemeeter mix), mute cannot remove it.
Origin: research AUG-174. Roadmap: M2 Live session control.

## Verification status (2026-11-03)
- Done: server/client/electron typecheck clean; server vitest 37 files / 585 tests pass; client vite build OK; merger smoke run (invalid intervals dropped, muted segment removed, "— mic muted 01:00–03:00 —" placed in time order).
- Done: Windows dev-build check by the user ("всё хорошо") after two UI fixes (see Грабли).
- PENDING: macOS check in a release build (v0.1.0).
- Notes: Ghost Coin expanded width grew 248 → 296 px to fit four buttons; the "You're muted" hint needs the Web Audio graph (no hint in the track.enabled fallback); the fallback has no device re-acquire path (pre-existing), so re-apply only runs where reattach exists.

## ✅ Итог (2026-11-03)
**Что сделано:**
- Mic mute во время записи без остановки: mic-файл сохраняет wall-clock длину, [Them] остаётся выровнен с [Me].
- Тоггл везде: Mic circuit node и кнопка в live top bar (standard), Dock Strip/Square, Ghost Caption/Coin, tray-чекбокс «Mute microphone» (только во время записи), глобальный Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+M (настраивается в Settings → Desktop).
- muteIntervals уходят с upload, хранятся в session.json; batch-merge (и retranscribe) выкидывает muted [Me]-сегменты и пишет строки «— mic muted mm:ss–mm:ss —»; live показывает «— mic muted —».
- Подсказка «You're muted in August» при речи в mute (~2 с), гаснет на unmute или через 5 с тишины.
**Как:** GainNode micSource → gain → recordDest с ramp 15 мс; fallback track.enabled без Web Audio; reattachMic подключается в тот же gain. Отвергнуты MediaRecorder.pause / track.stop (рассинхрон треков). Сегмент выкидывается при ≥50% внутри muted-интервала, в dual-режиме интервалы сдвигаются на micShiftSec. Gap-строки без [HH:MM:SS], т.к. transcriptCorrections.ts и TranscriptView считают timestamp-строки индексами реплик. hotkey.ts — per-slot реестр, unregisterAll только на will-quit. Анализатор хинта стоит до gain, RMS-гейт 0.006 как у live chunker.
**Файлы:** @client/src/components/FileUpload.tsx, @client/src/components/LiveTranscriptPanel.tsx, @client/src/components/compact/DockWidgets.tsx, @client/src/components/compact/GhostApp.tsx, @client/src/App.css, @server/src/services/transcriptMerger.ts, @server/src/routes/sessions.ts, @electron/src/hotkey.ts, @electron/src/main.ts, @electron/src/tray.ts.
**PR / коммиты:** без PR, прямо в master: b3dad84 (AUG-181), a7038dd (version 0.1.0); тег v0.1.0, релиз собран CI (Windows + macOS) и опубликован.
**Грабли:** «Unmute mic» был белым — dark-theme `.live-panel-btn` перебивал специфичность, нужны селекторы с `:root[data-theme='dark']`; Mic node в default-режиме не кликался — `.circuit-recording .circuit-node--corner` имеет pointer-events: none / opacity .3, нужен override для top-right.
**Хвосты:** проверка на macOS в релизной сборке v0.1.0; хинт не работает в track.enabled fallback; микрофон, попавший в системный трек, mute не убирает; OS-индикатор микрофона остаётся включённым.
